s: Programmatic SMS delivery for notifications, verification codes, and time-critical alerts via carrier networks.
w: Receives SMS request (phone number, message, optional templates for compliance) via API, routes through carrier aggregators or direct carrier connections, handles delivery receipts (DLR) via webhooks, and manages opt-out lists (STOP/START). Two-way SMS enables interactive workflows. Character limits (160 GSM / 70 Unicode) affect message composition and cost.
use: Time-critical alerts: fraud alerts, delivery updates, appointment reminders
Customer engagement in regions where SMS dominates (emerging markets)
avoid: Non-urgent notifications where email or push is cheaper and richer
Marketing blasts (cost-prohibitive at scale compared to email/push)

props.sender_id: Alphanumeric or short code for branded sender

size.messages_per_sec: ~100-1k per provider account depending on throughput limits

pits: Delivery latency spikes during carrier congestion - use multiple provider failover paths
Cost escalation from long messages split across segments - count characters and optimize templates
tips: OTP delivery speed matters more than almost any other SMS use case - mention provider selection for latency
Carrier filtering of A2P (application-to-person) messages requires registered sender IDs
